🔄 Content Update (Published: November 20, 2026 / Previously posted: October 29, 2026)
Main change: Most city website functions have been restored. Email delivery system and Nishikawa Broad-Area Forest Union website remain suspended.

【Restoration of Hanno City website functions】

Following emergency security measures (application of a security patch) for a vulnerability in the PHP programming language system, the city website functions that were temporarily suspended have now been fully restored.

However, the following services remain suspended:

Residents appreciate your patience and understanding. These are important safety measures to ensure you can use our services securely. We will announce restoration as soon as it is complete.

【Services temporarily suspended】

• Hanno City Email Delivery System
• Nishikawa Broad-Area Forest Union Website

【Suspension period】

The restart date is not yet determined. Services will be resumed sequentially as safety measures are implemented.

【Related links】

National Cyber Security Center (Alerts and Warnings) - X

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/sogoseisakubu/hishokohoka/joho/14546.html
summary: ℹ️ Hanno City website functions restored following PHP security fix
